items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Like when I was playing with Lloyd Price Band, Chuck McClendon wanted a raise

ctx.x: Yeah, that was pretty interesting about how you change bands. Mm-hmm. But that's real practical. It's very practical.

And you know, like some of those guys, now when I asked, one time I, I forgot what band it was for a raise, and he told me, and I knew that he was making it, because he had just come out with a new record and it was hot. I said, I think it's time for me to get a raise. Oh man, I can't give you no raise now. I said, I might be able to give you. I said, when are you going to give me a raise? He said, but two months from now, I'll be able to give you a raise. I said, well, here's my two weeks' notice. Now when you…
